item.title: Father's Little Dividend
item.description: In this sequel to Father of the Bride (1950), newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are going to have a baby, leaving her father having to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

item.title: Cleopatra
item.description: Cleopatra VII, the young queen of Egypt, struggles to resist the imperial ambitions of Rome after the assassination of her Roman husband, Julius Caesar.

item.title: Zorba the Greek
item.description: An uptight English writer is changed forever after meeting an amoral Greek peasant in Crete.

item.title: Breaking Away
item.description: A small-town boy who's obsessed with the Italian cycling team vies for the affections of a college girl.

item.title: The Paper Chase
item.description: When a struggling Harvard law student falls in love with his strict professor's daughter, he is torn between coursework and her free lifestyle.

item.title: Titanic
item.description: Unhappily married and uncomfortable with life among the British upper crust, Julia Sturges takes her two children aboard the Titanic for a new life in America. Her husband, Richard, also arranges passage on the doomed luxury liner with plans to gain custody of the children.

item.title: The Grapes of Wrath
item.description: After losing their farm during the Great Depression, an Oklahoma family sets out on an arduous journey toward California, where they hope to find work.

item.title: The Three Faces of Eve
item.description: A doctor treats a woman suffering from Multiple Personality Disorder.

item.title: On Golden Pond
item.description: An elderly man visits his summer home with his wife, where a new relationship with an impressionable teenager will change him.
